screens.name: 랜딩
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished PR-SIM Korean mobile WEB APP screen as a flat front-on product screenshot, portrait 1170x2532 pixels (390x844 CSS viewport at 3x), no phone frame, no browser chrome, no operating system status bar, no outer presentation board, no watermark. The app fills entire image.
Reference images: Oppie screenshots are STYLE ONLY: white canvas, pale neutral-gray spacious rounded cards, near-black primary buttons, black bold sans-serif, minimal flat surfaces, restrained layout. PR-SIM STAGE symbol is BRAND reference only; tiny blue/cyan stacked-slide play symbol next to black PR·SIM wordmark when appropriate. Sketch when provided is STRUCTURE reference only.
Shared design: background #FFFFFF, ink #111111, secondary #626262, surface #F5F5F5, card #ECECEC. Pretendard-like crisp Korean sans-serif. Layout 24 CSS px margins, headers 28px bold, body 16px, labels 14px, caption 12px. Cards radius28px, controls20px, chips pill-shaped, touch controls >=44px. Black full width CTA with white 16px semibold text, 56px height near bottom. No decorative shadows or colorful UI. Natural grayscale photographic human faces, all fictional Korean adults, consistent trio: friendly woman short bob 40s 민서, strict man glasses 50s 준호, probing man short hair 40s 도윤. Scenario throughout: 친환경 패키징 사업 제안. Sample presentation 5min, Q&A 3min. All content Korean except wordmark and small section numerals. Carefully render exact Korean labels as supplied; keep generous whitespace and clear hierarchy. Design must look like a real elegant functional app, not a poster.

LANDING. Header tiny STAGE symbol and PR·SIM wordmark left, 기록 right. Upper-middle centered small eyebrow '발표 시뮬레이터', large bold three-line headline '실전처럼 연습하고,\n자신 있게\n발표하세요.' and supporting 'AI 심사위원과 함께하는 발표 리허설'. Below a large rounded grayscale atmospheric photographic image of a quiet modern presentation stage with one microphone and projection screen, soft lighting, no people, no text overlay, approximately 340x260 CSS px. Tiny black dot ornament in lower right of photo reminiscent of Oppie. Ample breathing space. Bottom one wide black '시작하기 →' CTA and tiny centered '상황 설정부터 피드백까지, 한 번에.' Background photo must clearly exist as the hero image.
